support.text:  Volunteer agrees not to, without prior written consent from the Certification Council for Professional Dog Trainers, divulge any Confidential Information to third parties or copy documents containing any Confidential Information.

 Volunteer agrees to maintain the confidentiality of all Confidential Information and not misuse, misappropriate, or disclose in writing, orally or by electronic means, any Confidential Information, directly or indirectly, to any other person or use them in any way, either during the term of this Agreement or at any other time thereafter, except as is required in the course of service to the CCPDT.

 If a situation arises where it is unclear as to whether a conflict of interest exists, Volunteer shall discuss the issue with the President of the Certification Council for Professional Dog Trainers (or the Vice President if the Volunteer is the President).
 The Certification Council for Professional Dog Trainers’ e-mail distribution list(s);
 Human resources data and information about employees, contractors and other volunteers;
 Any goods or services Volunteer provides to the Certification Council for Professional Dog Trainers under this Agreement.
 Any other information to which Volunteer has access while involved in the Certification Council for Professional Dog Trainers’ activities.
A Committee Chair plus any two members of the Executive Committee may elect to remove a volunteer at any time.

support.text: The Receiving Party shall not disclose, allow access to, transmit or transfer the Confidential Information to any third party without the Disclosing Party’s prior written consent, provided however that the Receiving Party may disclose the Confidential Information to those of its directors, officers and employees ("Representatives") who have a need to know the Confidential Information for the Purpose provided that the Receiving Party shall ensure that such Representatives treat the Confidential Information as confidential and at all times in a manner consistent with this Agreement and the Receiving Party shall be liable for any loss or damage resulting from any Representative failing to do so.

5. In the event that the Receiving Party is required to disclose Confidential Information pursuant to any applicable law or an order from a court of competent jurisdiction, the Receiving Party shall only disclose such portion of the Confidential Information that it is legally required to disclose, and shall use all reasonable efforts to obtain confidential treatment for any Confidential Information so disclosed.

The Receiving Party shall promptly notify the Disclosing Party of the required disclosure and any relevant information in respect thereto so that the Disclosing Party may take appropriate steps to protect such Confidential Information from such disclosure.

acquisition_contract.admission: Strict trigger-parent improvement, every old parent nondecreasing, complete mixed-version table and compatible interfaces unchanged. Creation is not CoRev and read formatting is not Lift or CoRev.
acquisition_contract.comparison: Full and Generic receive the identical real Free B2 seed, same source texts, native TRAIN supervision, failure records, common runtime and one independently generated free proposal block each. Any scheduled Lift is evaluated equally. This isolates update mechanisms; it is not independent seed acquisition.
acquisition_contract.computation: The helper computes the legal permission/applicability and native consequence. READ supplies literal source parameters, never the full native label or the final permission decision. A declaration or runtime support span is not independent semantic gold.
acquisition_contract.objects: The two genuinely acquired existing helpers and their actual USE. Preserve useful rule boundaries; do not force two changes, add a gratuitous helper or manufacture an old defect. A necessary single edit is a valid result.
acquisition_contract.question: Repair the actual source-role/qualification mismatch in the existing legal dependency, using the simpler current primitive/flat-array interface. A nested-record READ attempt is not promoted: one response confuses notification duties with permissions and the other repeats to the output limit.
acquisition_contract.scope: Disclosure tasks nda-5/nda-7 only where supported; the two other native views retain normal fallback and remain in the same parent score. No source-ID/native-answer lookup or hidden case-specific branch.
acquisition_contract.source_parameters: Keep recipient classes, recipient ownership/roles, purpose/context and conditions distinct where the learned calculation uses them. Each list consumed as individual class names must contain class atoms, not a full qualified sentence or a protected-information category. Do not infer a permission from a prohibition or notification duty. Missing law stays unknown.

changes_since_last_teacher: Complete READ/premise edit transplantation and actual code/source responsibility contexts implemented and offline checked.
Source-rule reads exclude the native question and use one evidence-ID namespace.
Retire the failed nested-record read; make atomic role/qualifier semantics explicit in the common acquisition contract and prompt.
interpretation: Report single-sufficient/absorption and failures. A local accepted package is not cross-parent pattern benefit. Reuse with the already-updated program is ordinary skill reuse unless a learned pattern actually changes candidate generation.
workload: Two independently generated teacher responses, one per arm, each at most one free block. Evaluate any pre-scheduled Lift and the free block with the original 1..3-edit complete table; then freeze and execute the fourth pre-fixed TRAIN parent once per arm. No repeat proposal, full matrix or TEST.
